title: Optimal distribution of phosphorus compounds in multi-layered natural fabric reinforced biocomposites
authors: K. Bocz; B. Szolnoki; A. Farkas; E. Verret; D. Vadas; K. Decsov; G. Marosi
source_version: Final published journal article; complete publisher PDF
source_document_description: Complete 13-page publisher PDF, printed pages 606–618; methods, numerical text, tables and Figures 1–3 inspected
source_material_form_TGA_raw: Untreated or DAP/urea-treated plain woven flax fabric before incorporation into PLA laminates; TG aliquot handling unreported
TGA_specimen_preparation: Approximately 5–10 mg of the corresponding fabric was heated from 25 to 500 °C at 10 °C/min under 25 mL/min nitrogen. Cutting, grinding, pan, conditioning and replication are unreported.
LOI_method: ISO 4589; measured lowest oxygen concentration supporting specimen combustion; instrument unreported
LOI_statistic: Reported measured value; replicate count and uncertainty unreported
LOI_specimen_preparation: The corresponding untreated or treated plain woven flax fabric was tested before PLA lamination. LOI specimen dimensions and separate conditioning are unreported.
source_numeric_evidence_description: R500 from explicit thermal-results prose; measured LOI from Table 3, with the 20% DAP/U LOI also stated in section 3.1.1. No graph coordinates, fitted equations or cone residue values are used.
conditions_locator: Sections 2.1.1 and 2.2, printed pages 608–609; Table 1, page 609; sections 3.1.1–3.1.2, pages 610–611
LOI_locator: Table 3, printed page 611; own measured ISO 4589 method, page 609
source_location: Final publisher PDF pages 3–6, printed pages 608–611: preparation, TG/LOI methods, Tables 1 and 3, and thermal-results prose
source_residue_definition: Residual mass at 500 °C in nitrogen TGA, as defined in section 3.1.2 and Figures 1b and 3b
source_initial_degradation_definition: Initial degradation temperature; no stated mass-loss threshold or tangent-onset criterion. Source values remain outside canonical onset and T5 fields.
limitations: The paired observations refer to plain woven flax fabric before incorporation into PLA laminates. Initial degradation temperatures lack an explicit onset criterion or mass-loss threshold and remain source-native. Other points shown only in unlabelled plots are not digitized, and PLA-film or laminate LOIs do not inherit fabric TG. The 5 w/V% DAP/U residue is held because the prose reports 36%, whereas its Figure 3b marker lies below the 35% gridline; no replacement is estimated. Section 3.1.2 also alternates between DAP/U solution concentration and DAP concentration when describing the 5% treatment; no correction is inferred. LOI instrument, specimen dimensions, replication and uncertainty, and TG pan and aliquot handling are unreported. The four-specimen mean belongs to vertical flame testing and is not assigned to LOI or TG. The 185 °C fabric exposure is a separate mechanical experiment and is not assigned to these TG/LOI states. No durability-washed pair is established.
sample_state: 0 w/V% DAP/U; untreated plain woven flax fabric
composition: Plain woven flax fabric, 200 g/m², received from Meshining Engineering Kft., Győr, Hungary
treatment_method: Plain woven flax fabric was used as the non-treated reference. The treatment-specific immersion, foulard pressing and oven drying are not automatically assigned to this control.
washing_state: Untreated reference; no durability wash assigned
TG_locator: Section 3.1.2, printed page 611: residue of 18% from non-treated flax at 500 °C in nitrogen; Figure 3b provides a consistency check
source_residue_entry_raw: The residue of 18% remained from the non-treated flax fabric.
source_residue_qualifier_raw: No approximation qualifier on the control value
pairing_evidence: Table 3 identifies the 0 w/V% non-treated fabric with measured LOI 20. Section 3.1.2 assigns R500 18% to the same non-treated fabric; neither value is taken from the later PLA laminate.

sample_state: 20 w/V% DAP/U, DAP:U = 1:1; treated plain woven flax fabric
composition: Plain woven flax fabric treated in a 20 w/V% total DAP/urea aqueous solution with a 1:1 mass ratio; Table 1 explicitly lists DAP concentration 10 w/V% for this ratio. Retained add-on is unreported.
treatment_chemistry: Diammonium phosphate and urea, total bath concentration 20 w/V%, DAP:U mass ratio 1:1
treatment_method: Plain woven flax fabric, 200 g/m², was immersed for 2 min at room temperature in aqueous DAP/urea solution of total concentration 20 w/V% and DAP:U mass ratio 1:1. washing_state: Initial treated fabric after foulard pressing and oven drying; no durability wash assigned

The section explicitly assigns LOI 38 and residue (38%) to that state; Table 3 repeats measured LOI 38 at 20 w/V% DAP/U with the 1:1 ratio stated in section 3.1.2. These are one preparation state, not two observations to count separately.
